pharmacology.text: MCOPPB is a drug which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the nociceptin receptor, with a pKi of 10.07 and much weaker activity at other opioid receptors. It has only moderate affinity for the mu opioid receptor, weak affinity for the kappa opioid receptor and negligible binding at the delta opioid receptor.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied in animals for anxiety-reducing effects. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，曾在動物身上研究其減輕焦慮的作用，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，曾在动物身上研究其减轻焦虑的作用，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It targets the nociceptin receptor, the fourth member of the opioid receptor family, which barely responds to classic opioids such as morphine.
fact.zh: 它作用於痛敏肽受體，這是鴉片受體家族的第四個成員，對嗎啡等傳統鴉片類幾乎沒有反應。
fact.zhHans: 它作用于痛敏肽受体，这是鸦片受体家族的第四个成员，对吗啡等传统鸦片类几乎没有反应。
